title: U.S. House · Florida's 18th District
area: Polk County and the Lakeland/Winter Haven area in central Florida, under Florida's 2026 congressional map.

context.text: Florida's U.S. House elections use a new congressional map for 2026; Gov. Ron DeSantis signed the new district boundaries into law on May 4, 2026.
Both the Republican and Democratic primaries were canceled: incumbent Rep. Scott Franklin (R) and Curtis Gibson (D) each advanced unopposed.

summary.text: Scott Franklin is the incumbent Republican U.S. Representative for the 18th District. He is a former naval aviator and small business owner.

background.text: Born in Thomaston, Georgia; graduated from Lakeland High School.
Served in the U.S. Navy from 1986 to 2000 and the U.S. Navy Reserve from 2000 to 2012; earned a bachelor's degree from the U.S. Naval Academy and an MBA from Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University.
Career included owning an insurance agency and working as a naval aviator before entering Congress in 2021.

record.text: Serves as Vice Chair of the House Appropriations Subcommittee on Agriculture, Rural Development, FDA and Related Agencies, and also sits on the Energy and Water Development subcommittee, for the 2025–2026 Congress.

summary.text: Curtis Gibson is a former Lake Wales City Commissioner and commercial property manager running as the Democratic nominee against incumbent Scott Franklin.

background.text: Graduate of Lake Wales High School; earned an Associate's degree in Criminal Justice and a Bachelor's degree in Interdisciplinary Business Studies.
Served as a Lake Wales City Commissioner from 2017 to 2021; has worked as a school board janitor, U.S. Postal Service mail carrier, Amazon Air employee, and commercial property manager.

priorities.text: Says he will champion policies that protect labor, lower the cost of living, and support working families, citing his own work history as a janitor, mail carrier, and warehouse employee.
Says he wants to drive economic revitalization and small business growth in the district using his property-management experience.
Emphasizes public accountability and transparency in government, drawing on his experience as a city commissioner.

summary.text: Deva Simmons is running with no party affiliation in the general election for Florida's 18th District. No campaign website or detailed public statements were found.

researchNotes: Curtis Gibson did not state specific policy positions on the fixed issue list in his Candidate Connection survey, so no Positions are recorded. Federal key votes and FEC finance totals for incumbent Scott Franklin are added separately by script. No public information found for Deva Simmons beyond her ballot listing.
